name: coffee-shopp-crm
description: Coffee shop & coffee business management platform — POS, inventory, recipes/BOM, CRM, promotions, multi-branch, RBAC, and P&L dashboard.

scripts.db:reset: prisma db push --force-reset && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: prisma generate && prisma db push && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/test.db prisma db push --force-reset --skip-generate && DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/test.db tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.ts
